electricity--noun.def: The power that runs lamps and machines.
electricity--noun.ex: The storm cut off our electricity.

standard--noun.def: A level of quality that people expect.
standard--noun.ex: The hotel keeps a high standard.

inform--verb.def: To officially tell someone about something.
inform--verb.ex: Please inform us of any change.
inform--verb.exTr: Lütfen her değişiklikten bizi haberdar edin.

status--noun.def: A person's position in society, or the state of something.
status--noun.ex: Check the status of your order.

purse--noun.def: A small bag for money, or a handbag.
purse--noun.ex: She left her purse on the bus.

trigger--noun.def: The part of a gun you pull to fire it.

exit--noun.def: The way out of a building or a road.

exit--verb.def: To leave a place or a program.
exit--verb.ex: Exit the motorway at junction five.

cancel--verb.def: To decide that a planned event will not happen.

clinic--noun.def: A small place where people receive medical care.

vice--adj.def: Second in rank, just below the leader.

generous--adj.def: Happy to give money, time or help.
generous--adj.ex: He is generous with his time.

gain--noun.def: An increase, or something useful you get.
gain--noun.ex: The report shows a small gain.

gain--verb.def: To get something useful, or to increase.

jungle--noun.ex: The river runs through the jungle.

link--noun.def: A connection between things, or an address on a website.
link--noun.ex: Send me the link by email.

link--verb.def: To connect two things or show a relation between them.
link--verb.ex: The bridge links the two districts.

religious--adj.def: Relating to religion, or having strong belief.

routine--noun.def: The usual order in which you do things.
routine--noun.ex: Exercise is part of my routine.

equal--adj.def: The same in size, number or value.
equal--adj.ex: Cut the cake into equal pieces.

incredibly--adv.def: Extremely, or in a way hard to believe.

divorced--adj.def: No longer married because the marriage legally ended.

port--noun.def: A town or place where ships load and unload.
port--noun.ex: The ship reached port at dawn.

nephew--noun.def: The son of your brother or sister.
nephew--noun.ex: My nephew starts school this year.

proceed--verb.def: To continue doing something after a pause.

patience--noun.def: The ability to wait or accept trouble calmly.

recording--noun.def: Sound or pictures that have been stored.

foolish--adj.ex: It was foolish to go alone.

cage--noun.def: A box of bars where animals are kept.
cage--noun.ex: The bird flew out of its cage.

pattern--noun.def: A repeated design, or a regular way things happen.
pattern--noun.ex: The cloth has a simple pattern.

someplace--adv.def: In or to some place, in American English.

aim--noun.def: What you are trying to achieve.
aim--noun.ex: Our aim is to cut waste.

cliff--noun.def: A high steep rock face, often by the sea.
cliff--noun.ex: The path runs along the cliff.

nail--noun.def: A thin metal pin, or the hard part on a finger.
nail--noun.ex: Hammer the nail into the wood.

interrupt--verb.def: To stop someone while they are speaking or working.
interrupt--verb.exTr: Öğle yemeğinizi böldüğüm için özür dilerim.

satisfied--adj.def: Pleased because you got what you wanted.

election--noun.def: The process of choosing someone by voting.
election--noun.ex: The election is held every five years.

warrior--noun.def: A brave fighter, especially in the past.
warrior--noun.ex: The poem tells of an old warrior.

fetch--verb.def: To go somewhere and bring something back.
fetch--verb.ex: Fetch me a glass of water.

complex--adj.def: Made of many connected parts and not simple.

frozen--adj.def: Turned to ice, or kept very cold to last longer.

guilt--noun.def: The bad feeling of having done wrong.
guilt--noun.ex: She felt no guilt at all.

officially--adv.def: In a formal way, announced by an authority.

wrap--noun.def: A cover put around something, or a rolled sandwich.

wrap--verb.def: To cover something by folding material around it.
wrap--verb.ex: She wrapped the gift in blue paper.

behalf--noun.def: Used to say you are acting for someone else.
behalf--noun.ex: He signed on behalf of the company.

reasonable--adj.def: Fair and sensible, or not too expensive.

motive--noun.def: The reason why someone does something.

bishop--noun.def: A senior Christian priest in charge of a region.
bishop--noun.ex: The bishop opened the new school.

dealer--noun.def: A person or shop that buys and sells goods.
dealer--noun.ex: The car dealer offered a discount.

nearby--adj.ex: We ate at a nearby café.

benefit--noun.def: An advantage that something gives you.

apology--noun.def: Words that say you are sorry.

thus--adv.def: As a result, in a formal style.
thus--adv.ex: The road was closed; thus we waited.

pipe--noun.def: A tube that carries water or gas.
pipe--noun.ex: A pipe burst under the street.

goods--noun.def: Things that are produced to be sold.

loyal--adj.def: Always supporting a person or a group.

atmosphere--noun.def: The air around the earth, or the mood of a place.
atmosphere--noun.ex: The café has a warm atmosphere.

pit--noun.def: A deep hole in the ground.
pit--noun.ex: They dug a pit for the rubbish.

rotten--adj.def: Decayed and no longer good to eat or use.

organization--noun.def: A group of people working together for a purpose.

comment--noun.def: Something you say or write giving an opinion.

shelter--noun.def: A place that protects you from weather or danger.
shelter--noun.ex: They found shelter under a tree.

flow--noun.def: The steady movement of liquid or traffic.
flow--noun.ex: The flow of the river slowed.

flow--verb.def: To move steadily in one direction.

strip--noun.def: A long narrow piece of something.
strip--noun.ex: Cut the paper into thin strips.

monk--noun.def: A man who lives in a religious community.
monk--noun.ex: A monk showed us the library.

slightly--adv.ex: The room is slightly warmer now.

judgment--noun.def: The ability to decide wisely, or a court's decision.

existence--noun.def: The state of being real or living.

ward--noun.def: A large room in a hospital with several beds.
ward--noun.ex: She works on the children's ward.

actress--noun.def: A woman who performs in films or plays.

individual--adj.def: Considered separately rather than as a group.
